paper_id: A Smart Contract Generation Method Based on Blockchain Patterns and Model-driven Multi-party Service Agreements
title: A Smart Contract Generation Method Based on Blockchain Patterns and Model-driven Multi-party Service Agreements
motivation: Multi-party service agreements face trust issues under centralized execution; blockchain offers decentralization but contract development is complex.
problem_framing: Three challenges: (1) extracting blockchain-relevant content from agreement text, (2) modeling agreements for blockchain without cross-domain barriers, (3) automatically generating deployable smart contract code.
key_insight: Combine LLM-assisted clause extraction, MDA-based modeling (CIM→PIM→PSM), and a multi-level smart contract reuse library indexed by blockchain patterns to enable automated code generation.
method_signature: MDA-based smart contract generation via LLM extraction + blockchain pattern reuse library
evaluation_criteria: Case study validation: generated Solidity code passes Slither security checks, deploys on Remix, and authorization functions execute correctly.
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: Still some non-automated steps in converting blockchain analysis results into CIM; smart contracts become immutable after deployment—future work will explore update methods.
thinking_moves: 从复杂文本中分离出适合区块链执行的内容(LLM+句法依存分析)
用MDA三层模型(CIM/PIM/PSM)保持模型转换中区块链语义不丢失
用区块链pattern作为代码复用的索引粒度,组织多层级reuse库
用case study+安全检查工具验证可行性,而不是性能benchmark
